text:
Harper: Tiny office drama  found a merge with `version: who-knows` in package.yaml 
Harper: also a solo `\t` in the YAML that made the parser cry. 🤦‍♀️
Eli: haha classic. tab: 1 - YAML: 0
Dana: propose ritual: before merging, run `yapf --forgiveness` and offer cookies to the parser.
LintBot: lint: ERROR - non-semver token "who-knows". Suggest `0.0.1-who-knows` or consult your therapist. :robot_face:
Greg: can we add a commit-msg hook that rejects words like "maybe", "foo", "who-knows", and "soon(tm)"?
Eli: +1. Also we should have a "compiler hug" emoji in reactions.
Harper: posted a GIF of a compiler getting a tiny band-aid :heart:
Dana: quick poll: if your semver was a dating app status, which one? 1) single 2) it's complicated 3) beta w/ baggage
Greg: votes "beta w/ baggage" and pins a note: "Do not release until emotionally ready." :stuck_out_tongue:
Harper: fixed file, replaced tab with spaces, bumped to 0.1.0 and left a consolatory comment. thanks y'all :party_popper:
